name: card-refund

description.en: The Stripe half of a refund (W-REFUND). When an order the card paid for is refunded (POST /api/staff/orders/:id/refund, owner or staff holding `void`), the venue's object records a card attempt on the order (`refund.card.attempts[n]`: amount in the order's units, status `queued`, the Idempotency-Key sha256(venue|order|n)) and queues ONE outbox entry of kind `stripe_refund` in the same turn. The venue's drain (its alarm) sends POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/refunds with payment_intent = the PI the payment webhook recorded, amount = the card part converted to Stripe's units (a lek is 100 of them: ALL is two-decimal to Stripe), metadata {order_id, venue, key, attempt}, `Idempotency-Key` and `Stripe-Version: 2024-06-20`; retries are the outbox's (six over ~30 min, same key), a 4xx is final. Stripe's answer and its signed refund.* / charge.refunded webhooks write the refund id and status onto the attempt (de-duplicated by event fingerprint); when Stripe says `succeeded` for the WHOLE card part and the card was all the money taken, the order moves REFUNDING -> COMPENSATED_REFUND by itself. A refund event naming another venue or another payment is refused (200, never applied). Partial refunds: amount <= card paid - succeeded - in flight. The guest's order page says how much went back once Stripe confirms. Without STRIPE_SECRET_KEY the record says `manual` and the person refunds by hand in Stripe, then marks it refunded (`complete: true`). Also fixed on the way: create_intent sent lek unconverted (1/100 of the price) and the webhook wrote Stripe's units back as lek.
description.uk: Повернення на картку через Stripe: замовлення, оплачене карткою, повертається повністю або частинами з ключем ідемпотентності; вебхук Stripe закриває замовлення, коли вся карткова частина повернена.

producer.what: decide_card(): the card attempt planned (plan(), line 80) before any append, recorded on the order in the refund's turn; idem_key() line 38
the object turn: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY present -> the job; enqueue_card() writes the outbox entry after the log
send(): the drain's arm; post() line 21 (POST /v1/refunds); record() line 56 writes Stripe's word and closes the order
form(): the request body; classify() line 117; to_stripe()/from_stripe() the units
the drain routes kind stripe_refund to refund_io::send

consumer.what: webhook(): refund events, past the same signature check, to stripe/refund_hook.rs handle()
apply(): venue + payment checks, fingerprint de-dup, status rank; close() line 281: COMPENSATED_REFUND only when covered
openRefund(): card part / cash part / already refunded, amount field; cardLine() line 94: pending / refunded / failed: <reason> - try again; refundToCard() line 109
the guest's order page: refunded N, 5-10 days to reach the card

transport.auth: Bearer owner | staff with cap void

external_api_version: 2024-06-20 (Stripe-Version pinned on POST /v1/refunds only; create_intent sends none; webhook bodies follow the endpoint's version set in the Stripe dashboard)

secrets: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (Worker secret, ONE for the whole platform: there is no per-venue key today)
QA_STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY (sk_test_..., the SAME test account, for the probe to confirm the PI with pm_card_visa and read refunds back)
auth.where: /root/.dowiz_owner (probe); wrangler secrets (Worker). The probe REFUSES a key that is not sk_test_.

stripe_refund_request_schema.description: the form fields of POST /v1/refunds, as an object

tests_inmem: workers/api/src/command/refund/card/tests.rs (8 tests: key stability, amount bound, foreign venue/payment, close only on covered succeeded, failure + try again, dashboard refund, no key, cash order)
workers/api/src/stripe/refund/tests.rs (5 tests: units ALL x100, refusals, form, entry, classify)
workers/api/src/stripe/refund_hook/tests.rs (3 end-to-end in memory: half then rest via route/outbox/drain/fake Stripe/webhook; a 4xx refusal; no key)
probe: tools/live-proof/probes/feature-card-refund.mjs: Stripe TEST mode only on qa-durres: card order -> PI confirmed with pm_card_visa -> webhook marks paid -> refund half -> Stripe refund read back -> the rest -> COMPENSATED_REFUND -> charge.amount_refunded == the whole; rc 3 NEEDS-KEY without QA_STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY.
